source_visual_observations: Extended parallel horizontal lines AB and CD; rising line C-A, with extensions at both ends; AE descends to E; C=40°.
audit.independent_solution: CAB=180−40=140°. AE bisects CAB, giving EAB=70°. By parallel lines, AEC=70°, choice B.
